title: Seat Catch-Up Charge Computation, Professional Email Billing
content:
Billing calculation for a seat catch-up on a Professional Email subscription.

**Charge.** The seat catch-up charge is the catch-up seats times the plan seat price times the catch-up months times the catch-up fraction, reduced by any rate that applies to it, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

**Terms used.**
1. The charge that opened the current term is the new-subscription or renewal charge whose period start is the term start date; an added-seat or upgrade line never opens a term.
2. The seats billed for the current term are the seats on the charge that opened the current term plus the seats on added-seat lines whose period end is the term end date.
3. The catch-up seats are the catch-up target less the seats billed for the current term, never fewer than zero. The catch-up target is the seat count on the subscription.
4. The plan seat price is the product's annual-prepaid seat price, its annual-commitment price.
5. The catch-up months are the calendar months from the term start date to the term end date, the months the line covers.
6. The catch-up fraction is the calendar days from today to the term end date divided by the calendar days from the term start date to the term end date, the base proration of added seats, never below zero.

## Worked example (hypothetical subscription and price)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Seat count on the subscription | 41 |
| Seats on the renewal charge whose period start is the term start date | 33 |
| Seats on added-seat lines whose period end is the term end date | 3 |
| Catch-up seats | 41 less 36, that is 5 |
| Hypothetical annual-commitment seat price | 10.00 |
| Catch-up months (12-month term) | 12 |
| Catch-up fraction | 146 days left of 365, that is 0.4 |
| Seat catch-up charge | 5 times 10.00 times 12 times 0.4, that is 240.00 |

With a seat count of 36 and the same lines the catch-up seats are zero and nothing is billed.
